lede: Looking for physical media shops in Dhaka? We got you. Part 1 of our video guide to the city's analog hidden gems.
body:
If you've been asking where to find **physical media shops in Dhaka**, this is where our answer starts. On 11 September 2026 B-POP Tags posted Part 1 of a video guide under a simple headline: "Looking for physical media shops in Dhaka? We got you!"

## A video guide to physical media shops in Dhaka

The guide lives on Instagram as a video, and that's where the shops are shown. This page doesn't name them, so watch the original post for each spot. The hashtags tell you what kind of places to expect: #analogrevival, #hiddengemsdhaka, #retrovibes, #cassetteculture, #physicalmedia and #DhakaDiaries.

## Why go looking for analog

Hunting for physical media is half the fun. You spend time in small shops, flick through stacks, ask whoever's behind the counter what's worth hearing and leave with something you didn't plan to buy. In a city as dense as Dhaka, those shops are easy to walk past, which is exactly why a guide helps.

The story continues in [Part 2](post:physical-media-shops-dhaka-part-2). For the wider picture, read about [Dhaka's vinyl and cassette revival](post:dhaka-vinyl-cassette-revival), and for another corner of collector culture, our tribute to [Jamil's Comics](post:jamils-comics-bangladesh-comic-book-culture). More analog stories are on the [pop culture hub](topic:pop-culture) and the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

[See the original post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DdJiAnymvvn/)
